mapper.select: select fb.id as id, fb.title as title, p.nickname as authorName, fb.created_at as createdAt, fb.updated_at as updatedAt, (select count(*) from user_like_board ulb where ulb.board_id = fb.id) as likeCnt from free_board fb join user u on fb.author_id = u.id join profile p on u.profile_id = p.id where fb.is_removed = false limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset};

select fb.id as id, fb.title as title, p.nickname as authorName, fb.content as content, fb.created_at as createdAt, fb.updated_at as updatedAt, (select count(*) from user_like_board ulb where ulb.board_id = fb.id) as likeCnt from free_board fb join user u on fb.author_id = u.id join profile p on u.profile_id = p.id where fb.id = #{id} and fb.is_removed = false;
select id, saved_file_name as name, path, size from free_board_image_property where board_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into free_board (author_id, title, content, view_cnt, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) values (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{viewCnt}, #{isRemoved}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt});
mapper.update:
update free_board
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
view_cnt = #{viewCnt},
updatedAt = NOW()
where id = #{id};
update free_board set is_removed = true, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id};
